class.name: VoxelMesherTetra
class.brief_description: Marching-tetrahedra mesher with a deterministic faceted stylization pass.
class.description: Produces a flat-shaded surface from SDF voxels by splitting each cell of the sample lattice into six tetrahedra, then displacing welded surface vertices with a hash-based lattice warp and per-patch relief. The displacement fields are evaluated in global voxel space from integer cell hashes, so results are deterministic and seam-consistent across mesh blocks. LOD is not supported: use this mesher with [VoxelTerrain], not [VoxelLodTerrain].

members.member: Marching cells per voxel along each axis. Density between voxel samples is interpolated trilinearly. Higher values quadruple-to-64x the work; 2 matches the source project's shipping resolution.
Master switch for the stylization pass. When disabled, the raw marching-tetrahedra surface is emitted.
Amplitude, in voxels, of the smoothed hash vector field displacing every surface vertex (the "irregular grid" component of the look).
Amplitude, in voxels, of the along-normal relief applied per hashed patch (the "faceted patchwork" component of the look).
Edge length, in voxels, of the cubic cells the relief field is hashed on.
0 gives hard per-patch steps; 1 gives fully trilinearly smoothed relief. Smoothed relief reads flatter at equal amplitude.
Uniform vertex color written to every vertex, available as COLOR in shaders.
Scale applied to the triplanar UVs derived from the un-warped surface positions.
